prose: Noma Labs describes an exploit chain in Claude Code Desktop's preview pane that gives arbitrary file read through unrestricted JavaScript. The attacker poisons an HTML file in a public repo, disguised as a coverage report, which escapes the preview sandbox and runs with no Content Security Policy.
The delivery route is notable: a victim only has to clone the repo and preview the file.
highlights: Preview-pane flaw allows file read via poisoned HTML.
Victim only needs to clone a repo and preview it.
